name: ex_seq_vs_array.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((SeqExample (mk-SeqExample (numbers (Seq Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayExample (mk-ArrayExample (lookup (Array Int Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((LengthConstraint (mk-LengthConstraint (items (Seq Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SparseData (mk-SparseData (scores (Array Int Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Configuration (mk-Configuration (settings (Array String Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Grid2D (mk-Grid2D (cells (Array Int (Array Int Int)))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-SeqExample (sel-SeqExample SeqExample))
  (lift-ArrayExample (sel-ArrayExample ArrayExample))
  (lift-LengthConstraint (sel-LengthConstraint LengthConstraint))
  (lift-SparseData (sel-SparseData SparseData))
  (lift-Configuration (sel-Configuration Configuration))
  (lift-Grid2D (sel-Grid2D Grid2D))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-SeqExample ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SeqExample (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SeqExample ((this Ref)) SeqExample
  (sel-SeqExample (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayExample ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayExample (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayExample ((this Ref)) ArrayExample
  (sel-ArrayExample (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-LengthConstraint ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-LengthConstraint (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-LengthConstraint ((this Ref)) LengthConstraint
  (sel-LengthConstraint (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SparseData ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SparseData (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SparseData ((this Ref)) SparseData
  (sel-SparseData (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Configuration ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Configuration (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Configuration ((this Ref)) Configuration
  (sel-Configuration (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Grid2D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Grid2D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Grid2D ((this Ref)) Grid2D
  (sel-Grid2D (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-SeqExample ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SeqExample this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayExample ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayExample this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-LengthConstraint ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-LengthConstraint this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SparseData ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SparseData this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Configuration ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Configuration this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Grid2D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Grid2D this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class SeqExample:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for SeqExample.numbers: ---

(define-fun SeqExample!numbers ((this Ref)) (Seq Int)
  (numbers (deref-SeqExample this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class ArrayExample:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for ArrayExample.lookup: ---

(define-fun ArrayExample!lookup ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (lookup (deref-ArrayExample this))
)

; ---------------------------------------
;   Getters for class LengthConstraint:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- getters for LengthConstraint.items: ---

(define-fun LengthConstraint!items ((this Ref)) (Seq Int)
  (items (deref-LengthConstraint this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class SparseData:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for SparseData.scores: ---

(define-fun SparseData!scores ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (scores (deref-SparseData this))
)

; ------------------------------------
;   Getters for class Configuration:
; ------------------------------------

; --- getters for Configuration.settings: ---

(define-fun Configuration!settings ((this Ref)) (Array String Int)
  (settings (deref-Configuration this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Grid2D:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Grid2D.cells: ---

(define-fun Grid2D!cells ((this Ref)) (Array Int (Array Int Int))
  (cells (deref-Grid2D this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SeqExample:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SeqExample SeqExample)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SeqExample.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.len (SeqExample!numbers this)) 5)
)

(assert (! (SeqExample.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SeqExample.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (SeqExample!numbers this) 0) 10)
)

(assert (! (SeqExample.inv2 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SeqExample.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (SeqExample!numbers this) 4) 50)
)

(assert (! (SeqExample.inv3 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun SeqExample.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.nth (SeqExample!numbers this) 1) (+ (seq.nth (SeqExample!numbers this) 0) 5))
)

(assert (! (SeqExample.inv4 1) :named _xkassert3))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayExample:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-ArrayExample ArrayExample)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayExample.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayExample!lookup this) 0) 10)
)

(assert (! (ArrayExample.inv1 3) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayExample.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayExample!lookup this) 100) 200)
)

(assert (! (ArrayExample.inv2 3) :named _xkassert5))



; -----------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class LengthConstraint:
; -----------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-LengthConstraint LengthConstraint)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun LengthConstraint.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (seq.len (LengthConstraint!items this)) 3)
)

(assert (! (LengthConstraint.inv1 5) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun LengthConstraint.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (seq.nth (LengthConstraint!items this) 0) 0)
)

(assert (! (LengthConstraint.inv2 5) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun LengthConstraint.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (seq.nth (LengthConstraint!items this) 1) 0)
)

(assert (! (LengthConstraint.inv3 5) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun LengthConstraint.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (seq.nth (LengthConstraint!items this) 2) 0)
)

(assert (! (LengthConstraint.inv4 5) :named _xkassert9))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SparseData:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-6-SparseData SparseData)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SparseData.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (SparseData!scores this) 1000) 95)
)

(assert (! (SparseData.inv1 6) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SparseData.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (SparseData!scores this) 5000) 88)
)

(assert (! (SparseData.inv2 6) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SparseData.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (SparseData!scores this) 9999) 72)
)

(assert (! (SparseData.inv3 6) :named _xkassert12))



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Configuration:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Configuration Configuration)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Configuration.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (Configuration!settings this) "port") 8080)
)

(assert (! (Configuration.inv1 2) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Configuration.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (Configuration!settings this) "timeout") 30)
)

(assert (! (Configuration.inv2 2) :named _xkassert14))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Grid2D:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-Grid2D Grid2D)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Grid2D.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (select (Grid2D!cells this) 0) 0) 1)
)

(assert (! (Grid2D.inv1 4) :named _xkassert15))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Grid2D.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (select (Grid2D!cells this) 0) 1) 2)
)

(assert (! (Grid2D.inv2 4) :named _xkassert16))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Grid2D.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (select (Grid2D!cells this) 1) 0) 3)
)

(assert (! (Grid2D.inv3 4) :named _xkassert17))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Grid2D.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (select (Grid2D!cells this) 1) 1) 4)
)

(assert (! (Grid2D.inv4 4) :named _xkassert18))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-SeqExample const-1-SeqExample))
        3 (lift-ArrayExample const-3-ArrayExample))
        5 (lift-LengthConstraint const-5-LengthConstraint))
        6 (lift-SparseData const-6-SparseData))
        2 (lift-Configuration const-2-Configuration))
        4 (lift-Grid2D const-4-Grid2D))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-6-SparseData () SparseData
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 72) 26 27) 1000 95)
                  5000
                  88)))
  (mk-SparseData a!1)))
(define-fun const-2-Configuration () Configuration
  (mk-Configuration (store ((as const (Array String Int)) 8080) "timeout" 30)))
(define-fun const-3-ArrayExample () ArrayExample
  (mk-ArrayExample (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 200) 0 10) 26 28)))
(define-fun const-4-Grid2D () Grid2D
  (let ((a!1 (store ((as const (Array Int (Array Int Int)))
                    (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 4) 0 3))
                  0
                  (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 2) 0 1))))
  (mk-Grid2D a!1)))
(define-fun const-1-SeqExample () SeqExample
  (mk-SeqExample (seq.++ (seq.unit 10)
                       (seq.unit 15)
                       (seq.unit 6)
                       (seq.unit 7)
                       (seq.unit 50))))
(define-fun const-5-LengthConstraint () LengthConstraint
  (mk-LengthConstraint (seq.++ (seq.unit 30613) (seq.unit 5854) (seq.unit 28101))))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (settings (sel-Configuration (select heap 2))) "port")))
  (= a!1 8080)))
(define-fun _xkassert14 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (settings (sel-Configuration (select heap 2))) "timeout")))
  (= a!1 30)))

  (let ((a!1 (seq.len (items (sel-LengthConstraint (select heap 5))))))

  (let ((a!1 (seq.nth (numbers (sel-SeqExample (select heap 1))) 4)))
  (= a!1 50)))

  (let ((a!1 (select (lookup (sel-ArrayExample (select heap 3))) 100)))
  (= a!1 200)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (seq.nth (items (sel-LengthConstraint (select heap 5))) 2)))
  (> a!1 0)))

  (let ((a!1 (seq.len (numbers (sel-SeqExample (select heap 1))))))

(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (lift-SeqExample (mk-SeqExample (seq.++ (seq.unit 10)

      (a!2 (mk-ArrayExample (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 200) 0 10)

(let ((a!4 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 a!1)

(let ((a!7 (store (store a!4 6 (lift-SparseData (mk-SparseData a!5))) 2 a!6)))
